o: Season two ushers in the return of Los Angeles' iconic private detective and film connoisseur, John Sugar, in a new case, tracking the troubled older brother of an up-and-coming local boxer, as his search for his beloved missing sister continues. As the investigation expands into a citywide conspiracy with sinister intentions, Sugar must reckon with himself to answer the question — how far will…

eps.o: Sugar takes on a new case: Tracking down the troubled brother of rising local boxer Danny Moon.
The search for Ji sends Sugar into dangerous territory. Danny resorts to desperate measures.
Danny gets a lead on Ji. Back at the Del, Sugar finds himself with a new admirer.
Sugar makes a powerful enemy and has a falling out with Charlotte. The race to find Ji is on.
Vega isn't convinced his problem with Ji is solved. Sugar befriends someone in Pavich's inner circle.
Sugar wrestles with his fear of contamination. Vega forces Sugar to make an impossible choice.
With every other option spent, Sugar plays one last card. Charlotte opens up to Sugar.
Sugar attends an event that shakes him to his core.
